correctness.rationale: All hypotheses and boundary characteristics checked. Radial-socle multiplication yields a nondegenerate rank-two symmetric form, whose projective perpendicular involution has exactly 0/2 or 1/q+1 fixed lines. Uniform fibers of size q(q−1) yield the explicit join-decomposition. Chromatic, automorphism and spectral polynomial formulas follow from exact graph components and equitable cells. Twelve full finite-field graph checks, two mixed-characteristic ring checks, and direct binary coloring checks and four exact-integer spectral characteristic-polynomial checks passed; computations do not replace proof.
